prompt.text: From the inside out, which order is correct?

hints: The space that pushes neighbours away is always last.
cards.fullLine: A box runs from content, through padding and border, out to margin.

prompt.text: Space between the content and the border is

answer.text: Space between the content and the border is padding.

hints: The background colour shows in this space.
cards.fullLine: Space between the content and the border is padding.

teaching.text: It sits between the content and the border, so the background shows behind it.

prompt.text: Space outside the border is the

answer.text: Space outside the border is the margin.

hints: It never takes the background colour.
cards.fullLine: Space outside the border is the margin.

teaching.text: It pushes neighbours away and is never painted by the element.

prompt.text: With `box-sizing: border-box`, the width includes what?

hints: The margin is never part of a width.
cards.fullLine: With box-sizing: border-box, the width includes content, padding and border.

prompt.text: Which display value lays children out in a row or a column?

cards.fullLine: The flex display value lays children out in a row or a column.

prompt.text: When two rules set the same property, the one with higher

answer.text: When two rules set the same property, the one with higher specificity wins.
